skill.name: email-sequence-designer
skill.description: Use when the user asks to "design a welcome flow", "set up an abandoned-cart sequence", "build a light re-engagement branch inside a lifecycle flow", or "plan a cold-outbound sequence"; produces general lifecycle automation flows (welcome, cart, browse-abandon, post-purchase, in-flow re-engagement, B2B cold outbound) with trigger, step timing, branch/exit conditions, goal, frequency governance (send caps, quiet hours, fatigue guardrail), a sunset path, and a SEND N-dimension score. Not for the closed-loop win-back / re-consent (re-permission) program on a lapsed cohort — use reactivation-specialist; not for writing each email's copy — use email-creative-builder; not for computing EQS or the N1 unsubscribe veto — use email-quality-auditor. 邮件自动化流程设计/购物车挽回/流失召回序列
skill.summary: Design lifecycle email flows with timing, branching, frequency controls, sunset rules, and SEND N scoring.
skill.author: aaron-he-zhu

security_audit.summary: Most detections are Markdown fences, inline code, metadata URLs, and documentation links, so they do not execute commands, access URLs, traverse files, or read environment data. The Resend activation instruction at SKILL.md line 52 is a real external command with a live email-sending side effect, but it requires a preview, user confirmation, and consent checks. No prompt injection or covert exfiltration intent was found.

remediation.issue: The Resend workflow can execute a live broadcast command.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit confirmation immediately before every live broadcast, and validate the segment, sender, schedule, consent, and suppression state.

content.value_statement: Disconnected campaigns create poor timing, irrelevant messages, and subscriber fatigue. This skill designs coordinated flows with clear triggers, branches, exits, and frequency controls.
actual_capabilities: Maps welcome, cart, browse, post-purchase, light re-engagement, and B2B outbound flows.
Defines triggers, ordered steps, timing, goals, branches, and exit conditions.
Sets global send caps, quiet hours, and engagement fatigue guardrails.
Designs re-engagement touches and suppression or sunset rules.
Scores the SEND N dimension for a selected email profile.
Produces a reusable handoff summary for creative development and quality review.
limitations: It does not write complete subject lines, bodies, or calls to action.
It does not design closed-loop re-consent programs for lapsed cohorts.
It does not compute final EQS results or enforce quality vetoes.
Live Resend activation requires connector access, validated consent, and explicit user approval.

use_cases.title: Launch a welcome flow
use_cases.description: Create a timed onboarding sequence with activation goals, engagement branches, and conversion exits.

use_cases.title: Recover abandoned carts
use_cases.description: Plan reminders, incentive branches, purchase exits, and frequency limits for an ecommerce store.

use_cases.title: Structure outbound nurture
use_cases.description: Build a multi-step prospect sequence with reply exits, segment relevance, and fatigue controls.

prompt_templates.title: Basic welcome sequence
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a three-step welcome flow for [product] and [audience]. Use [signup event] as the trigger and include timing and exits.
prompt_templates.scenario: Start a simple lifecycle flow from known inputs.

prompt_templates.title: Abandoned-cart sequence
prompt_templates.prompt: Build an abandoned-cart flow for [store]. Include three steps, a discount branch, quiet hours, and an immediate exit after purchase.
prompt_templates.scenario: Recover likely purchases without excessive contact.

prompt_templates.title: Lifecycle program review
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these current flows and metrics: [details]. Identify missing flows, redesign cadence, add fatigue controls, and calculate the SEND N score.
prompt_templates.scenario: Improve an existing email automation program.

prompt_templates.title: Advanced multi-flow architecture
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a [profile] lifecycle system for [segments]. Map flow transitions, trigger validation, branches, exits, global caps, sunset logic, assumptions, and handoffs.
prompt_templates.scenario: Coordinate several flows under one governance policy.

output_examples.input: Design a welcome flow for a project management application. Trigger on verified signup.
output_examples.output: Welcome flow: Send orientation immediately, feature guidance after two days, and a progress reminder after five days. Exit on paid conversion or unsubscribe.

output_examples.input: Create an abandoned-cart sequence with a discount branch and strict fatigue controls.
output_examples.output: Cart flow: Remind after two hours, branch on product-page return, offer an incentive after 24 hours, and exit immediately after purchase.

best_practices: Provide the exact trigger event, target segment, platform, and current flow details.
Separate measured facts, user-provided facts, and estimated timing assumptions.
Validate consent, suppression status, send caps, and exit conditions before activation.
anti_patterns: Do not enroll every subscriber without lifecycle-stage or consent checks.
Do not let subjects remain in a flow after conversion, reply, unsubscribe, or bounce.
Do not activate live broadcasts before reviewing the preview and confirming recipients.

faq.question: Can this skill write every email?
faq.answer: No. It designs flow structure and hands each step to an email copywriting skill.

faq.question: Which lifecycle flows are supported?
faq.answer: It supports welcome, cart, browse, post-purchase, light re-engagement, and B2B cold-outbound sequences.

faq.question: Does it support win-back campaigns?
faq.answer: It supports light in-flow re-engagement. Closed-loop win-back and re-consent programs are outside its scope.

faq.question: What information should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide the flow goal, trigger event, audience segment, platform, current cadence, and available complaint or unsubscribe signals.

faq.question: Can it send campaigns automatically?
faq.answer: It can propose Resend connector commands. Live sending requires a preview, consent validation, and explicit user confirmation.

faq.question: What does the SEND N score measure?
faq.answer: It evaluates lifecycle coverage, timing, segmentation relevance, goal progression, and available frequency options for the selected profile.
